title: Indistinction
summary: INDISTINC'TION, noun Want of distinction; confusion; uncertainty. The indistinction of many of the same name-- hath made some doubt. 1. Indiscrimination; want of distinction. 2. Equality of condition

inlines.v: INDISTINC'TION, noun Want of distinction; confusion; uncertainty. The indistinction of many of the same name-- hath made some doubt. 1. Indiscrimination; want of distinction. 2. Equality of condition or rank.
